recordWizard-desc: Qalab si fudud loo isticmaali karo oo si toos ah u duuba faylasha ku dhawaaqista codka.
mwe-recwiz-prevent-close: Waxaad ku dhowdahay inaad ka baxdo boggan. Dhammaan duubista codadka ee aan la daabicin way lumi doonaan. Ma doonaysaa inaad haddana ka baxdo?
mwe-recwiz-retry: Mar kale isku day soo gelintii fashilantay
mwe-recwiz-tutorial-reopenpopup: Dib u fur daaqadda soo boodda
mwe-recwiz-tutorial-activate: Fadlan oggolow gelitaanka makarafoonkaaga si aad u sii waddo.
mwe-recwiz-tutorial-help:
==== Waa kan sida loo sameeyo: ====
# Markaad diyaar tahay, guji badhanka "Bilow tijaabada" si aad u bilowdo tijaabada duubista.
# Eray cod dheer ku dhawaaq, tusaale ahaan "qorraxda".
# Dhagayso duubistaada si aad u hubiso inay sax tahay.
# Haddii loo baahdo, hagaaji habaynta makarafoonkaaga.
# Haddii wax walba sax yihiin, waxaad u gudbi kartaa tallaabada xigta!
mwe-recwiz-tutorial-info: Si aad u barato sida loo habeeyo makarafoonkaaga, booqo [[Special:MyLanguage/Help:Configure_your_microphone|boggan caawinta]].
mwe-recwiz-tutorial-mictester-info: Markaad diyaar tahay, riix badhanka hoose si aad u bilowdo duubista tijaabada.
mwe-recwiz-speaker-warning: Macluumaadkan si guud ayaa loo soo bandhigi doonaa waxaana lala xiriirin doonaa duubistaada.
mwe-recwiz-speaker-licensecontent: Aniga, $1, waxaan si aan laga noqon karin qof kasta siinayaa xaqa uu ku isticmaali karo duubista codadkayga ee aan ku abuuray qalabkan iyadoo la raacayo shatiga soo socda:
mwe-recwiz-speaker-agreement: Waxaad oggolaanaysaa in si toos ah loogu isticmaali karo mashaariicda Wikimedia ee kala duwan, oo ay ku jiraan Wikipedia, Wiktionary iyo Wikidata.
mwe-recwiz-details-placeholder: Halkan ku qor erayga la duubayo
mwe-recwiz-details-help: Si loo kala saaro laba eray oo isku qoraal ah, ku caddee macnaha qawsyada dhexdooda, tusaale ahaan: live (fal, in la noolaado) iyo live (sifo, si toos ah loo baahinayo).
mwe-recwiz-details-addwords: Qor eray oo riix <Enter> (ama dhowr eray adigoo isticmaalaya # sidii kala soocaha)
mwe-recwiz-details-deduplicate: Ka saar erayada hore loo duubay
mwe-recwiz-studio-info-audio: Guji $1 ee hoose, ka dibna erayga kor ugu akhri
mwe-recwiz-studio-info-video: Guji $1 ee hoose, ka dibna erayga akhri oo ku qor
mwe-recwiz-videostudio-webcamaccess: Fadlan u oggolow Lingua Libre inay gasho kamaraddaada webka.
mwe-recwiz-videostudio-clicktostart: Guji badhanka hoose si aad u bilowdo.
mwe-recwiz-publish-info: Hubi duubistaada ka hor intaadan bilaabin daabiciddooda.
mwe-recwiz-publish-commonsfilelist: Ka hubi waxyaabaha aad ku soo gelisay Wikimedia Commons
mwe-recwiz-publish-nomedia: Hadda ma jiro warbaahin la doortay.
mwe-recwiz-allsucceeded: Dhammaan gelinnadii si guul leh ayay u dhaceen!
mwe-recwiz-somefailed: Qaar ka mid ah gelinnada way fashilmeen.
mwe-recwiz-settings-delaybetweenrecords: Dib u dhaca u dhexeeya duubista:
mwe-recwiz-error-mediastream-notallowed: Ma aadan oggolaan gelitaanka makarafoonka. Si aad u isticmaasho RecordWizard, gal dejimaha biraawsarkaaga si aad u oggolaato, ka dibna guji badhanka hoose.
mwe-recwiz-error-mediastream-notfound: Makarafoon lama helin. Si aad u sii waddo, waa inaad heshaa mid oo ku xirtaa qalabkaaga.
mwe-recwiz-error-mediastream-technical: Khalad farsamo oo ka jira biraawsarkaaga ama nidaamkaaga hawlgalka ayaa ka hor istaagaya isticmaalka makarafoonkaaga. Isku day inaad dib u soo rogto bogga. Faahfaahinta khaladka: $1
mwe-recwiz-error-mediastream-unknow: Khalad aan la garanayn ayaa ka hor istaagaya isticmaalka makarafoonkaaga. Isku day inaad dib u soo rogto bogga.
mwe-recwiz-error-noname: Waa inaad magac u doorataa ku hadlahaaga.
mwe-recwiz-error-duplicatename: Waxaad hore u leedahay ku hadle la yiraahdo $1. Mid kasta oo ka mid ah ku hadlayaashaadu waa inuu lahaadaa magac ka duwan.
mwe-recwiz-error-nolanguages: Waxaan hubaa inaad ku hadasho ugu yaraan hal luuqad ;)
mwe-recwiz-error-emptylist: Waa inaad doorataa erayo si aad u sii waddo.
mwe-recwiz-error-network: Lama awoodo in lala xiriiro server-ka. Fadlan hubi isku xirkaaga internetka oo mar kale isku day.
mwe-recwiz-warning-wordsleft: Waxaa jira erayo qaar oo haray, ma hubtaa inaad halkaas ku joojinayso?
mwe-recwiz-warning-pendinguploads: Dhammaan duubistaadu weli lama gelin, ma rabtaa inaad joojiso?
mwe-recwiz-warning-faileduploads: Qaar ka mid ah duubistaada lama gelin cilad shabakad awgeed, ma rabtaa inaad ka saarto?
mwe-recwiz-nearby-coordinates-help: Ku qor isku duwayaasha qaabka jajab tobanle.
mwe-recwiz-nearby-limit-help: Waa inuu noqdaa tiro dhan oo u dhexeysa 1 iyo 500.
mwe-recwiz-nearby-deduplicate: Ka saar erayada aad hore u duubtay
mwe-recwiz-error-cantgetposition: Booskaaga lama heli karo, waa inaad isku duwayaasha gacanta ku dejisaa ($1).
mwe-recwiz-warning-noresults: Ma jiraan waxyaabo u dhow isku duwayaashan.
mwe-recwiz-list-title-help: Cinwaanka bogga ku jira meel magacyada liiska.
mwe-recwiz-list-deduplicate: Ka saar erayada aad hore u duubtay
mwe-recwiz-wmcategory-title-help: Magaca qaybta, oo ay ku jirto meel magaca Qaybta.
mwe-recwiz-wmcategory-deduplicate: Ka saar erayada aad hore u duubtay
mwe-recwiz-wmcategory-limit-help: Waa inuu noqdaa tiro dhan oo u dhexeysa 1 iyo 2000.
mwe-recwiz-list-error-nopage: Fadlan geli magaca bogga ay ku jirto liisku.
mwe-recwiz-error-pagemissing: Hadda ma jiro bog leh magaca "$1".
mwe-recwiz-error-nowiki: Ma jiro Wikipedia ama Wiktionary ku qoran luqaddaada.
